invented.quote: This year that elevator has been out of service on 41 days, about one day in every eight.
invented.why: The brief does not state the current date, so it is impossible to calculate that 41 days is about one-eighth of the year so far.

invented.quote: Five months later we are still waiting, and you have given us no reason to trust this estimate more than the last one.
invented.why: The brief only says that an inspection took place in September and does not state that the current month is November (five months after June).

invented.quote: We are willing to hear the reasons, but a one-line answer is not enough for a request backed by most of the people who live here.
invented.why: The brief summarizes management's response regarding the second elevator, not that management actually gave the tenants a 'one-line answer'.
